signals.title: EBA analyseert stablecoin-gebruik in gedecentraliseerde financiering
signals.summary: The European Banking Authority (EBA) today published a Report analysing the use of EMTs and other selected stablecoins in DeFi and the implications for consumers and supervisors. The EBA finds that stablecoins, including some EMTs issued under the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA), play a central role in the DeFi ecosystem by providing liquidity, collateral and settlement in DeFi trading and lending activities. The Report also highlights consumer protection, and regulatory arbitrage risks arising from the growing interaction between stablecoins and DeFi.
